item.title: US aircraft leave second UK base weeks after Fairford withdrawal
item.body: US military aircraft have left a second UK base. The departures come weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford airbase over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🛩️ US aircraft leave second UK base weeks after Fairford withdrawal

US military aircraft have left a second UK base. The departures come weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford airbase over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

Source: BBC | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 10 November, 11:50
